[quote=lyuongo;61565274][spoiler=[b][i]ESCAPE FROM NAYPINAU![/i][/b]]
[i]President Tung took one last look around the Presidential Palace. It was quiet, bar the helicopter idiling on the roof, awating his appearance. 

Just miles to the south, on the National Highway, the roar of revolution reverberated through the Lyuongoan countryside. Thousands of men, trucks and the red spirit were on a collision course to the capital. Tung ordered the preparation of defenses along the ancient city quarters, however, he knew it was only a matter of time. The remaining troops in Naypinau were to flee to the major port city of Uria, while the rest of the remaining loyalists were to report to command stations in Durgo, Jayunggi and Ryuloga. It would be best now to take stock and prepare their counterattack when the LNA could pick the board in which the final game will be played. Various LMC-employed militias have also pledged loyalty towards the LNA... but you can't exactly rely on mercenaries to be ride or die allies. Tung knew that.

"Your execllency. It's time, we have to go now before the LNSA can get their jets sortied!"

The rain came down in sheets. Fighting in the Naypinau streets were marked with blurred flashes and bangs, but the hundreds of bodies that now lay dead and disfigured in the wet pavement are gracefully covered by the fog of the rain, which washes blood, guts and limbs down the street gutters. Tanks, covered by the fog, trampled mercilessly over friend and foe alike in the confusion. Artillery hit about as many belligerents as it hit civilians. The song of smoke, fog and fire rang out to both the damned and the innocent that night. Even still, the LNSA pushed on, rallied by the great national hero. By the time the sun rose in the morning to shine over the wounded and dead, the LNSA cut off any exits from Naypinau for the remaining loyalists, and from there, it was shooting fish in a barrel. The remaining massacre would last deep into the 18th of May, as the remaining souls of the loyalists would be vanquished with an revolutionary exorcism of the city, regressed to a morbid mass grave covered in bits of pieces of rubble and human matter. In  the meantime, sandbags and barbed wire defenses were being prepared around the perimeter of Uria, with the knowledge that for the LNA to recieve the support it needs for its counterattack, [b]Operation 5692[/b], they had to hold the city of Uria for as long as possible. A job placed into the hands of decades-old tanks and a few thousand men with the resolve of a nation on their backs. They would need every little bit of that resolve, as the Navy, now in Hein Wei's hands, has cut off their escape. They must fight long enough for victory or die waiting for a savior.[/i]
[/spoiler]

[b]Wuloosyan-Rosenmarkket War: Results of Operation Wailord[/b]

"This meeting of the Joint Operations Room for the White Sea Conflict will commence. The President first wants to hear a status report on the damage inflicted to the Rosenmarkeet fleet during Operation Wailord." Matthis Vanderrow starts.

Hendel Crossrik "Like we suspected, most of the Rosenmarkett navy was unprepared for our attack, and their surface to air defenses proved insufficient to stop the brunt of our attacks. Data I received from the Office of Strategic Services will confirm what I am about to say. We have crippled several naval facilities, sunk 10 frigates, 4 destroyers, and severely damaged a CATOBAR Carrier. This means likely that a large portion of Rosenmarkee's surface fleet will be unable to operate, and the ships that will be able to will likely be swept aside in Wailord Stage 2."

Julian looks up at the general, just having got out of a press conference about the attacks directly in Wuloosya.

"Yes...this great and all...but 4 of our citizens just died to retaliatory strikes by Rosenmarkee, and granted the ceasefire is in effect now, so we can expect no more strikes...but what do we plan to do to prevent such issues in the first place...This strike has already raised concerns, and polls are well, not doing well."

Vanderrow starts to speak, "Well, I believe personally that this is on us, we didn't anticipate that they would actually attack us. And therefore our air defense was slow to react..."

Rensley Whitkor speaks up

"So, we have come to the near-unanimous conclusion that, given our air defense capability, further strikes are not a concern at this time. However, the military needs more mobility to install systems directly in cities where they will be the most useful, just for now."

Julian nods, "Continue."

Vanderrow nods and begins, "So, regarding their retaliation, beyond what has already been discussed. Their cyber attacks have also been moderately successful. New Davikianstad's power grid is down for now; the OSS and FIB is working on restoring it but we are unsure how long that is going to take. Macro Cosmos told us it was due to outdated software, additionally most government sites were down for a few hours; however I'm told that they have been restored as of now."

"I'm tempted to not ask, but what were our casualties during this operation?" Julian inquires

Vanderrow responds "Well, during the Baltemuur strike, one of our destroyers was damaged, nobody was on board at the time, and it's one of our older ones. It will take about 3 weeks for it to be fully operational. More concerningly, one of our F-222 aircrafts was shot down over Rosenmarker, from what we know the pilots survived and are now POWs."

"Dammit." Julian replies. 

Whitkor passes some files to julian "So we wanted to suggest a new operation in retaliation. Operation Rotom." 

"Really, tell me more..." Julian replies

__________________________________________________

"My fellow Wuloosyans..." Julian begins his address to the nation.

"Due to recent events, we live in a time of uncertainty. The war has finally reached our sacred shores.

Last night, we saw a horrific attack on Wuloosya by the Rosenmarket against civilian facilities at the port of Baltemuur. The first time any enemy has attacked our nation since 1945. As your president. I swore to God and to the nation that I would deliver only the truth to the Wuloosyan people. Many have asked why this tragedy occurred, and why 4 Wuloosyans are dead, and many more are injured.

I come to tell you tonight that this was a failure beyond proportion from the Department of War, and a failure to coordinate with the Civil Defense Administration. I promised the Wuloosyan people that I would be a president of strength, and today I must show strength. I will not allow this attack on Wuloosya's territory to go unpunished. 

Tonight. On my orders, the Wuloosyan Defense Force will begin preparations to launch a comprehensive offensive against the Rosenmarkket white sea islands. It is believed by the Office of Strategic Services that the attacks we saw tonight were directly launched from these islands. There can be no peace in this region until the military power of these islands is destroyed. To do that, these islands must fall directly under Wuloosyan occupation to ensure their demilitarization and the safety of white sea trade. To facilitate this, a series of executive orders have been signed by myself giving the Defense Forces the ability to transport the necessary weapons and men to the designated origin points for the operation, this means that some form of transport in certain areas will be prohibited, and the presence of military forces will become more common, especially on the coastline within the coming days. Additionally, to keep us safe from any future retaliation, the Defense Force and the Civil Defense Administration will be mobilized to their most possible extent, air defenses will be installed across the nation to defend our people.

I will not lie to you. There will be casualties. Already, 2 of our brave airmen have been captured by the enemy in combat operations. There is no doubt that there will be others as the war progresses. However, as we saw last night, if we continue to allow the belligerent and rogue Rosenmarket nation to fester, our nation will never be safe. The men and women of the Wuloosyan Defense Forces enlisted for one purpose: the defense of Wuloosya, the safety of her people, and her liberty. And today, I call upon them to serve this purpose with duty and honor.

I will give one final warning to Rosenmarkee. We may be at a ceasefire, but if they do not agree to permanently demilitarize these islands, The retaliation for the strikes in Baltemuur will be unlike anything seen in their history. 

Goodnight, and may godbless you all, and may godbless Wuloosya."

________________________________________________________

[b]Operation Wailord, Stage Two[/b]

[spoiler]With the dust mostly settling on stage one of the operation, the goal to lure out the Rosenmarkeet navy into a final decisive confrontation had shown so far mixed results. But the good news was that the ceasefire had provided the Joint Operations Room for the White Sea Conflict much-needed time to actually prepare for the second stage of Operation Wailord. Although it had gone through slight modifications, now a naval confrontation was no longer going to be under Wuloosyan terms, and therefore the Wuloosyan Navy needed to take a much more cautious stance than the ambitious blitz across the white sea that was initially planned. Instead, in addition to the forces that were already supposed to be present, the 6th Surface Action group would also be added to the plan. The Office of Strategic Services indicates to the WDNC and the JORWSC that Rosenmarket Navy, while yes, damage assessments to port facilities were still accurate, and they had lost much of the infrastructure needed to repair and refuel ships in the region, this did not mean the Rosenmarket Navy would be unable to engage, and told them they should have the fleets operate on battle alert once they begin their final approach due to the imminent threat that the Rosenmarket Navy might suddenly rush out in an attempt to blitz the naval forces. Additionally, the OSS has identified that the Rosenmarkket air force had begun dispersing to civilian airports and likely was ready to begin air sweeps over the islands and coast, meaning that Wuloosyan ships might be at risk to airborne attacks. With this information in mind, the JORWSC would begin re-planning the operation

Firstly, the First, Third, and Sixth Surface action groups would all be moved to Lislarney, protected by ground-based air defense and the fighter screen currently protecting the Wuloosyan coastline. The plan dictates that one day after the conclusion of the ceasefire, this concentration of forces would be completed. The surface action groups would be rolled into a singular command under the JORWSC, named the 1st Naval Expeditionary Force in the meantime, with Admiral Gertjan Ruurknick taking command of this task force. While this is ongoing, Wuloosya begins to increase maritime patrols over the white sea, hunting for any movement of the Rosenmarkket navy that could endanger the operation. These maritime patrol aircraft are fitted with Harpoon missiles with strict orders to sink any Rosenmarkket navy vessels in the area of the islands and then bolt back to Wuloosya if they are spotted. Supporting these pre operation intelligence efforts are the UK Soren Northwick and UKS Devran Crestfield, signals intelligence ships specially built to intercept enemy signals before relaying them back to the OSS HQ and other coastal communication facilities for relay to the fleet, 3 E-7 "Cramorant" AEW&C Aircraft, and several surveillance satellites watching the waters of the white sea for any enemy combatants. Secretly, NARA research aircraft also participate in the operation, surveilling the white sea under the guise of a weather research operation, but really, they are taking high-definition photos of the white sea. NARA offers some protests, stating that having this dual purpose will compromise their neutrality, but the JORWSC assures them that this is basically a benign activity that cannot be proven in the future anyway.

The WDEF will also play a role in the operation. Rosenmarkkee has carriers, which means enemy aircraft being in the area of any naval battle is a high possibility, and therefore, the 73rd Fighter Squadron, the 91st Fighter Squadron, and the 64th Fighter Squadron are dispatched to provide air cover to the fleet, refueling over the white sea whenever possible. The 73rd and 91st are equipped with F-25s, while the 64th is equipped with the F-17 "Flygon", aircraft all superior to Rosenmarkkee carrier craft. Additionally, the 81st Attack Squadron will provide air anti-ship support, all equipped with 4 Harpoon Ship Missiles externally, and another 2 internally. The F-222 is a potent weapon in terms of sea combat, and the JORWSC banks on its presence being able to assist in the elimination of any ships. On March 20th, the date of the end of the ceasefire, at around 6 pm. Ruurknick is given the green light from JORWSC HQ, and the 1st Naval Expeditionary Force leaves port on route towards the island. As planned, the fleet maintains a "haystack" distribution pattern while on route; the ships remain dispersed from each other, making it harder for an enemy to target all of them at once, while also being able to concentrate quickly if an enemy formation begins to approach the fleet, it will take them the rest of the night to reach the combat area around the islands. To cover these ships, a final barrage of 50 anti-ship ballistic missiles is launched from Wuloosya to bombard Rosenmark's remaining coastal facilities to delay their reaction time.[/spoiler]

[b]Operation Yveltal[/b]

[spoiler]When the ceasefire was declared, the OSS had begun a complex and in-depth analysis of the Rosenmarkket white sea islands, mostly by satellite and surveillance aircraft to formulate a report on defenses, strategic locations for an invasion, terrain, and strategic choke points that could be used for a blockade. The JORWSC, after several sleepless nights for the men at OSS HQ, had finally gotten their report on the state of the defenses on the islands. To put it simply, they were heavy. While the HDF had been hard at work intercepting reinforcements bound for the islands during the ceasefire, this did not lessen the magnitude of the islands' defenses. After all, they were a key choke point in the white sea and had seen significant reinforcement in previous conflicts. With this information, the JORWSC briefed the president right before the end of the ceasefire, saying that taking the islands was likely unrealistic, Julian said thusly that there was no backing down now, and the capture of the islands would be the end of the war. Then, he ordered the quote and quote "complete obliteration of the island's defenses". 

And with that, the JORWSC got to work devising a new operation that they had not originally planned for, nicknamed "Yveltal" after the ancient Pokémon known to take the lifeforce from all living beings, and that was exactly what the JORWSC would do. the Wuloosyan navy was already on the way to the islands, and therefore JORWSC would make a global announcement declaring the islands an exclusion zone for future military operations, stating that while they would allow ships of a humanitarian nature, that all ships will have to be stopped and searched on their way to islands at designated points, only ships from New Westmore given their military presence on the islands would be excluded from these searches, with the New Westemorian Government informed beforehand of points where there ships would be allowed to cross unimpeded and unsearched, any ships who entered through these designated region would not be searched at all actually with the navy under strict orders to not fire. Additionally, they would be informed that airbases with known New Westmorian positions would not be targeted during future operations. While this risks leaking to Rosenarmarkke through NW's diplomatic backchannels, preventing a far worse international incident is deemed an acceptable sacrifice in case of this scenario.

Fortunately the OSS had done a decent job of designing targets. The operation would involve the WDF, WDNK, and WDEF. On the WDF part, ground-based ballistic missiles would be readied, including 2 of Wuloosya's hypersonic glide vehicles. These weapons are attached to ballistic missiles, which propel them into the upper atmosphere before simply dropping them. This propels the vehicles at Mach 5, making their interception practically impossible, as almost all modern interceptors are incapable of intercepting objects of that speed. These vehicles then smack into the ground, releasing immense kinetic energy and obliterating whatever their target is, and their targets would be the early warning radar on the islands themselves, and then the next closest on the mainland. While this won't eliminate the threat of early warning radars, it will significantly degrade their effectiveness and give an advantage to the WDF. Normal ballistic missiles would be used for the  15-20 stationary radars and the 30-40 naval radars across the islands, with 160 being launched to significantly "double tap" these targets. These missiles would be launched first to give time for the second stage of the operation to begin. The second stage would be entirely on the WDEF, the 27th, 93rd, and 6th Attack Squadron; the 59th Fighter Squadron would be equipped with  AGM-158 JASSM/-ER stand-off cruise missiles. With the F-222s carrying 6 stand-off cruise missiles each, of the ER variant a total of 180 missiles between them, while the F-17s of the 59th can carry 5 normal AGM-158 JASSMs, with 50 between them, a total of 230 cruise missiles to be launched at the various communication centers, airbases labeled non strategic and not with a noted NW Presence, stationary fortifications, artillery positions, barracks, with tunnels across the islands also being targeted due to rosenmarkkee using them to hide weapons. Escort will be provided by the 47th Fighter Squadron, all 10 aircraft being equipped with their full interceptor package.
